---

- **Calories:** 3,500 kcal
- **Carbohydrates:** 612g (70%)
- **Protein:** 131g (15%)
- **Fat:** 58g (15%)

---

## MEAL SCHEDULE

### **BREAKFAST** | 7:00 AM
*~850 calories | C:155g | P:28g | F:12g*

- Oatmeal: 80g dry
- Banana: 150g (1 large)
- Honey: 40g (2 tbsp)
- Low-fat yogurt: 150g
- Almonds: 15g
- Water or weak tea

---

### **MID-MORNING SNACK** | 10:00 AM
*~400 calories | C:95g | P:10g | F:3g*

- White bread: 100g (2-3 slices)
- Jam: 50g (3 tbsp)
- Apple: 200g (1 large)
- Sports drink: 500ml

---

*~900 calories | C:168g | P:42g | F:16g*

- White rice: 200g cooked
- Grilled chicken breast: 150g
- Olive oil: 10ml
- Steamed carrots: 100g
- White dinner roll: 80g
- Orange juice: 250ml

---

### **AFTERNOON SNACK** | 4:00 PM
*~500 calories | C:110g | P:15g | F:8g*

- Bagel: 100g (plain)
- Peanut butter: 25g
- Honey: 30g
- Banana: 120g
- Sports drink: 500ml

---

### **DINNER** | 7:00 PM
*~750 calories | C:140g | P:36g | F:14g*

- White pasta: 180g cooked
- Lean ground turkey: 120g
- Tomato sauce: 150g
- Olive oil: 8ml
- Side salad (light): 100g

- Apple juice: 200ml

---

### **EVENING SNACK** | 9:30 PM
*~100 calories | C:22g | P:0g | F:5g*

- Rice cakes: 25g
- Honey: 20g
- Herbal tea

## HYDRATION STRATEGY
- **Total fluids:** 3-4 liters
- Water throughout day
- 1L sports drink (6% carbs)

✓ Sleep 8+ hours  
✓ Avoid high fiber (reduces GI distress)  
✓ Minimize fat/protein at dinner  
✓ Stay hydrated but not bloated  
✓ Eat familiar foods only  
✓ Finish last meal 3-4 hours before race  

**Race morning:** 300-400 cal easily-digested carbs 2-3 hours before start
